title: Google Trends Compare: unlimited keywords on one scale

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Any number of search terms (Google's own UI caps at 5). All of them come back on ONE shared 0-100 scale, so 40 brands or products are directly comparable. Each keyword x country = one billed keyword series ($0.004 on the Free plan).

geos.title: Countries
geos.description: ISO country codes (US, GB, DE, BR, IN, JP...) or WORLDWIDE. Each country gets its own consistent scale. Empty = US.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Presets: today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all (since 2004), or today N-y / N-m / N-d, or an explicit range "YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD". Google picks daily (<~8 months), weekly (<5 years) or monthly resolution unless you choose daily-stitched.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: auto = whatever Google returns for the range (daily/weekly/monthly; cheapest). daily-stitched = daily points for ANY range via overlapping 240-day windows; adds daily-history-year events ($0.003 per keyword x country x year on the Free plan) when the range is longer than 240 days.

scaleMode.title: Scale mode
scaleMode.description: accurate (recommended) = pre-rank pass + size-based tiers chained through shared link terms, so small keywords stay precise next to giants. fast = one shared anchor keyword (fewer requests, less precise for small terms). Same price.

outputFormat.title: Output format
enumTitles: One row per keyword x date
One row per date (keywords as columns)
outputFormat.description: long = one row per keyword x country x date (easiest to filter/chart). wide = one row per country x date with a values{keyword: value} object (much smaller dataset for big keyword sets). Same price.

anchorKeyword.title: Pre-rank anchor (optional)
anchorKeyword.description: Keyword used for the pre-rank pass. Empty = first keyword. Use a mid-volume term in your niche if your first keyword is tiny or huge.

verifySample.title: Verify against a real 5-term Google chart
verifySample.description: Makes one extra real 5-keyword Google request across tiers and stores the mean absolute error of the stitched scale vs Google's own chart in the QA record (typically 0.05-0.25 points). Free.

category.title: Category id
category.description: Google Trends category id (0 = all categories, e.g. 71 = Food & Drink, 7 = Finance). Disambiguates words like "apple".

property.title: Search property
property.description: Which Google search property to measure.

proxyMode.title: Proxy
proxyMode.description: Datacenter by default; switches to residential automatically after repeated datacenter failures.

residentialCountry.title: Residential proxy country
residentialCountry.description: Optional ISO country for residential exits.

pacingSecs.title: Seconds between Google requests (min 1.5)
pacingSecs.description: Minimum gap between Google requests (never below 1.5 s).

maxAttempts.title: Max attempts per request
maxAttempts.description: Retries with 2/4/8/16 s backoff; new IP after the 2nd failure.

fallbackAfterFailures.title: Switch to residential after N datacenter failures
fallbackAfterFailures.description: Datacenter failures before switching to residential (auto mode).

tierMaxRatio.title: Max size ratio inside a tier
tierMaxRatio.description: A tier only admits keywords within this size ratio of its top keyword (precision for small terms).

description: Compare any number of keywords on ONE consistent Google Trends 0-100 scale, in any countries, with optional daily history for any range. Pay per keyword series.
